attempts.sql: SELECT f.file_id AS file_path FROM code.files f WHERE f.is_test = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i JOIN code.files tf ON tf.file_id = i.file_id WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id AND tf.is_test = true) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.files tf2 WHERE tf2.is_test = true AND tf2.file_id = regexp_replace(f.file_id, '(^|/)([^/]+)$', '\1test_\2')) ORDER BY f.file_id

request:
Which Python files that are not test files (every file under tests/, including helpers such as tests/common.py and conftest.py, is a test file) have no associated test file at all, meaning no test file imports that module directly (importing only the top-level httpx package counts as importing httpx/__init__.py, not its submodules) and no test file's name is exactly test_ followed by the source file's name (e.g. test_asgi.py for asgi.py; test_decoders.py does not match _decoders.py)? Give the repository-relative file paths.

Requested output columns: file_path (string).
explanation: Selects non-test files from code.files and excludes any that are directly imported by a test file (via code.imports) or that have a sibling test file named test_<name>.py. The regexp_replace constructs the expected test path by prefixing the basename with test_.
sql: SELECT f.file_id AS file_path FROM code.files f WHERE f.is_test = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i JOIN code.files tf ON tf.file_id = i.file_id WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id AND tf.is_test = true) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.files tf2 WHERE tf2.is_test = true AND tf2.file_id = regexp_replace(f.file_id, '(^|/)([^/]+)$', '\1test_\2')) ORDER BY f.file_id
